title: PDL-* items
summary: Stock levels and balances across warehouses for the PDL-* pedal item family as of 26 October 2026.
body:
The `PDL-*` item family comprises bicycle pedal components used in assembly and maintenance across Northbridge Cycles facilities. As of 09:00 GMT on 26 October 2026, stock balances across warehouse locations include platform pedals PDL-01 and pedals PDL-02. Current inventory registers track on-hand, allocated, and on-order quantities across the Manchester and Leeds store locations.

## Stock positions

Inventory positions recorded as of 09:00 on 26 October 2026 are:

* **PDL-01** (platform pedals): At WH-MAN-STR, stock stands at 37 on hand, 0 allocated, and 10 on order [^r1].
* **PDL-02** (pedals): At WH-MAN-STR, stock stands at 156 on hand, 7 allocated, and 0 on order [^r2]. At WH-LDS-STR, stock stands at 16 on hand, 0 allocated, and 0 on order [^r2].

Detailed row-level lookups and warehouse inventory registers are maintained in [[data-stock-on-hand|Stock_on_hand_2026-10-26_0900]].
